name: Elias Varn
practice: Works on offset presses. Treats makeready, blanket washes and misregistered sheets as the image.

name: Sunhee Bak
practice: Generates images from press manuals and technical drawings, then outputs them through a fixed halftone screen.

name: Adaeze Mbanefo
practice: Riso and screenprint from 35 mm photographs of Lagos and Enugu. Registration tolerance is part of the work.

name: Hollis Grant
practice: Night photographs on 35 mm, contact printed from halftone film. Lamps, harbours, light sources.

name: Kenji Morisaki
practice: Gelatin silver prints from screened negatives. White surfaces, snow, plaster; the paper left unexposed.

name: Tomás Ferreyra
practice: Contact sheets shown uncut. River freight on the Paraná, one roll per sheet.

name: Marta Wilczek
practice: Photogravure of textile structures from Łódź mill archives. Warp density against screen ruling.

name: Yasmin Tazi
practice: Two-colour riso from photographs of Casablanca and Marseille. Fluorescent ink for direct sun.

name: Ruth Amsler
practice: Inkjet and offset test forms. Control strips, ink limits and densitometer readings as the printed subject.
